title.en: Tale 6 — The Key in the Light

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

source: retold in modern Hebrew by Claude — NOT native-validated

sentences.en: One evening Juha lost a key.
He lost it inside the house.
He looked for it a short time.
And then he went out to the street.
In the street stood a big lamp.
He searched on the stones with his hands.
A neighbour passed and saw him.
The neighbour asked: what are you looking for?
Juha said: I lost a key.

sentences.ar: השכן כרע גם הוא ועזר לו.
sentences.en: The neighbour knelt too and helped him.
They searched together for half an hour.
The neighbour asked: where did it fall?

sentences.ar: השכן קם וצעק: אז למה כאן?
sentences.en: The neighbour got up and shouted: then why here?
Juha said: in the house there is no light.

sentences.ar: הוא אמר: ופה יש אור טוב.
sentences.en: He said: and here there is good light.
